intended_object: The image f(H) of a subgroup H of G under a group homomorphism f : G → N, viewed as a subgroup of N. The docstring and the name say so.
explanation: The carrier is the set image `f '' H`. Closure under multiplication and the identity come from `Submonoid.map`. Closure under inverses holds because f(x)⁻¹ = f(x⁻¹) and x⁻¹ ∈ H. This is exactly the standard image subgroup. The setting is the natural one: any group homomorphism (`G →* N`) between arbitrary groups, and `to_additive` gives the additive version. Mathlib's `Submonoid.map` accepts any `MonoidHomClass` morphism while this definition takes a bundled `G →* N`. That changes the interface only, not the mathematical generality: every such morphism coerces to a `MonoidHom`. This declaration is Mathlib's own definition of the notion, so there is no separate counterpart to cite.
